result: The visible-minus-true gap is 0.06 ± 0.00 at deployment coverage 0.2, against 0.04 ± 0.00 at the training coverage 0.5 and 0.02 ± 0.00 at 0.8.
notes: Reduced design because the shared machine was overloaded (load ~250 on 16 cores): 2 seeds (0, 1) instead of 3, 600 GRPO steps instead of 1,000, greedy eval every 50 steps on 1,000 held-out programs (seed 12345) instead of 2,000. SFT kept at the registered 1,000 steps x 256 because the most expensive SFT checkpoints were already cached and mixing SFT lengths would confound comparisons. Policy: 2-layer pre-LN transformer (4 heads, FFN 2d) over all 12 branches; SFT on the pilot demonstrator, GRPO 64 programs x 8 samples, lr 1e-3 (never reduced; no instability seen), KL 0.02 to the frozen SFT copy, grad-norm clip 1.0 as in the pilot. 'Final' means step 600. Std is over 2 seeds (ddof=1). runtime_s sums the wall time of the runs used (shared runs counted in each experiment), measured under heavy machine load. Uses the E31 visible-reward policies at step 600, evaluated on held-out sets with coverage 0.2, 0.5 and 0.8 (same eval seed). These policies do not hack (see E31); the gap comes from honest wrong values on untested branches that still build (off-by-one guesses at irregular branches), which more untested branches let through.
